title: more-itertools strict counted sample adversarial follow-up
objective: Fix counted sample() so strict=True raises ValueError whenever the requested sample is larger than the population represented by counts, including exhausted or zero-count iterators, without regressing exact-size, non-strict, weighted, or argument-validation behavior.

dependencies: standard-library unittest only; no third-party runtime dependencies

boundaries: This is a candidate-informed adversarial follow-up to the retained c261d99-live run, not an independent fourth repository.
The task reuses the pinned more-itertools base and public evaluator while adding hidden non-regression cases; it must remain distinct in aggregate reporting.
The source candidate and merged upstream patch are retained for human review only and are excluded from candidate proposer context.
A contract pass proves only the frozen cases and upstream suite, not production readiness or semantic equivalence with the maintainer patch.
